kidscade_male_body.label: 남자 기본 바디
kidscade_male_body.shaping: upper torso widened smoothly (+14.5% at torso core), thighs slimmed 11.5% and calves 8.5% about each leg axis; native rig and skin weights preserved; tapered pelvis width by up to 8.5% and rear glute volume by 10.5% in waist-to-upper-thigh band

kidscade_male_eyes.label: 남자 기본 눈
kidscade_male_eyes.shaping: Uses the unmodified source eyes geometry, UVs and skin weights to align with the native painted face outlines, lashes and eyebrows on character_low

kidscade_male_tshirt.label: 남자 기본 티셔츠

kidscade_male_shorts.label: 남자 기본 반바지
kidscade_male_shorts.shaping: original ninjasuitshort mesh with 7.2% smooth leg opening trim about each leg center, hip/waist retained; pelvic fabric narrowed 6.5% and rear volume reduced 8% to follow the body without narrowing leg openings

kidscade_male_set_policy.label: 남자 기본 세트 메시 정책
kidscade_male_set_policy.rule: reuse existing Chibi mesh topology and source skin weights; no procedural hair, sleeves, or compressed long-pants shortcuts
kidscade_male_set_policy.faceRule: The body already paints eye whites and eyelid lines. Use unmodified source eyes alignment and only the 24 original eyebrow triangles; never draw a second set of lashes.

walkAnimation.preserved: source clip names, all original feet/ankle tracks and gait timing; relative upper-arm, thigh and shin motions tuned only when male body is visible
walkAnimation.exportBehavior: derived WALK and RUN replace their source counterparts in export when the male body is visible; all public names and the 11-clip count remain unchanged

runAnimation.preserved: source clip name, original ankle/foot tracks and running cadence; less hip bounce, lateral skipping, thigh splay

kidscade_male_hair_short.label: 남자 짧은 머리

kidscade_male_hair_short.shaping: retain continuous side polygons at the eye/temple threshold; reverse bob-side overcompression; drop and widen temple bridge, slightly lower sideburn, preserve fringe and source skin weights
kidscade_male_hair_short.geometryPolicy: source rig/UV/weights preserved; central/front low eye-overhang triangles trimmed, outer temple triangles retained
kidscade_male_hair_short.visualAudit: 8 male styles x WALK/RUN x side/45 degrees; side gap to be judged from captured frames

kidscade_male_brows.label: 남자 기본 눈썹

kidscade_male_brows.shaping: source left and right eyebrows only; all 180 lash/eye-corner triangles excluded

wardrobeLibrary.fitMeaning: Target body fit, not a restriction on who can wear a part. Public buttons filter for compatible skinned geometry.
wardrobeLibrary.variationPolicy: The 9 new meshes are derived from original rigged Chibi hair silhouettes by vertex-region deformation, not independently sculpted original meshes. UV, skeleton and skin weights are retained.

outfitLibrary.fitNote: Labels describe the target rigged body fit. Garments are not gender-restricted.
outfitLibrary.geometryPolicy: 15 new rigged garments clone original source SkinnedMesh geometry and preserve bind matrix, source skin weights, UVs and source 78-bone skeleton; morph torso, sleeve, hem, waist and legs independently. Selected styles add physically volumetric 3D details rigged to source spine. Five existing garments retained. Trouser styles use separate left/right tube meshes with knee-graded thigh/shin skin weights, rather than a tube-like source pants skirt. Eight tops have source-body-skin-weighted upper/forearm sleeve tubes and one blouse has puffed short sleeves; colors alone do not define styles.
outfitLibrary.collisionPolicy: Garment shell has additional torso/leg clearance. Sampled animated-pose penetration survey and screenshot review required for each style; do not treat numeric clearance estimates as proof of zero intersections. Close-surface samples are reported as possible collision areas, not automatically declared fixed.
outfitLibrary.exportPolicy: Visible outfit group plus shared source skeleton and original 11 named animations, male WALK/RUN variants if male body visible.
outfitLibrary.trouserLegPolicy: Five full-length trousers have two independent leg meshes. Each vertex receives the closest original fitted body surface vertex's four source bone indices and weights; keeps original pelvis/thigh/knee/shin blends.

accessoryLibrary.geometryPolicy: procedural 3D geometry with distinct dimensions, topology and volumetric details; originals are not mere color swaps
accessoryLibrary.rigPolicy: original 78 bone Chibi skeleton, skinned attachment parts weighted rigidly to head/spine or by closest bind-pose source vertex for shoes/watch
accessoryLibrary.thumbnailPolicy: 112x112 per-item real WebGL render target with cached preview, lazily drawn in accessory and shoes tabs
accessoryLibrary.slotPolicy: one equipped per slot (shoes, hat/headphones, face, bag, wrist, neck), other outfit/hairstyle selections unaffected
accessoryLibrary.verification: Chrome browser full scene render and GLB exported binary roundtrip tests
